rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKwinwin
Exhibition name: Rosie O'Donnell
rows.Origin:
Bred by Joseph F. Winchel (United States, 1998).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. as 'Rosie O'Donnell'.
rows.Bloom: Red blend, yellow reverse. Mild fragrance. 26 to 35 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Double (17-25 petals), high-centered to cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 3' to 4'7" (90 to 140cm). Width: 35" to 43" (90 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
